text_block_list.text:
Her performance that day was just so 
vividly unforgettable.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ORAAAAAAAHHH--!!

It possessed a sharpness to it, as if 
ready to tear something apart—

The sharpness in her eyes had not faded 
even after the race had ended.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Arima Kinen.

If I recall correctly, the Arima Kinen is 
the race Symboli Rudolf announced she'd be 
running in.
choice_data_list:
It looks like Rudolf will be racing too, 
though...

text_block_list.text:
Isn't this a race she'd want to avoid? Or 
so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I know.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ... You are my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So, there's something I gotta tell you. 
Give me a minute.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I know what's in your head. What you're 
thinking, what you're fretting over—all of 
it.

...It seemed she had seen that notebook 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I'll apologize for making you worry. 
But 'lonely'? Hell no, not a chance.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go out there and prove it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I avoided fighting simply because there 
was no value in it. Nothing more, nothing 
less.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll fight and surpass you at the 
'Arima Kinen'— and prove that my words 
were right."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So you don't need to do anything else. 
I'll take care of advancing everything.

...I'm not fully convinced. Even now, it 
sounds like I'm just trying to persuade 
myself.

Even so, she's trying to move forward in 
her own way. In that case—

From here on, I want to support her by 
watching over her. —Next is the Arima 
Kinen. The showdown with Symboli Rudolf.
